Aggregation.description: The Aggregation element contains an expression which is an aggregation of an expression.

AllRolesRef.description: The AllRolesRef element is used to reference all the roles in a visual.

And.description: The And element contains an expression which represents an "and" between two expressions that evaluate to a boolean value.

AnyValue.description:
The AnyValue element represents a wildcard value that will match any value in a column.
It may only be used as the Right expression in a Comparison expression with a ComparisonKind of Equal.

Arithmetic.description: The Arithmetic element contains an expression which is an arithmetic operation on two expressions.

Between.description: The Between element contains an expression which is a comparison between an expression and two bounds.

Column.description: The Column element contains an expression which is a reference to a column in a source table.

Comparison.description: The Comparison element contains an expression which is a comparison between two expressions.

Conditional.description: The Conditional element represents an operation to select between several possible cases or an optional default.

Contains.description:
The Contains element contains an expression which is a "contains" comparison between two expressions.
The operation is case insensitive and accent sensitive.

DateAdd.description: The DateAdd element contains an expression which is a dateadd calculation of an expression.

DateSpan.description:
The DateSpan element contains an expression which is a datespan calculation of an expression.
A DateSpan can be compared directly to a Date via Comparison or Between.

DefaultValue.description:
The DefaultValue element represents the model-defined default value for a column.
It may only be used as the Right expression in a Comparison expression with a ComparisonKind of Equal.

Discretize.description: Transforms a continuous space of numerical values into a discrete space of numerical values.

Exists.description: The Exists element contains an expression which represents confirming the existence of at least one instance of an expression.

FillRule.description: The FillRule element represents an operation to apply a dynamic fill operation.

FilteredEval.description: The FilteredEval element contains a set of filters to apply to the measure.

Floor.description: The Floor element represents an operation to round the specified expression toward zero to a multiple of the specified size.

GroupRef.description: The GroupRef element contains an expression which is a reference to a model grouping column.

Hierarchy.description: Hierarchy is an element which represents a reference to a hierarchy in a source table.

HierarchyLevel.description: HierarchyLevel is an element which represents a reference to a hierarchy level in a hierarchy.

In.description:
The In element contains an expression which is a comparison between an ordered list of expressions and a set of ordered lists of values.
If the tuple defined in Expressions matches any tuple defined in Values, then In returns true.

Literal.description: The Literal element contains an expression which is a literal value.

Max.description: The Max element contains an expression whose max aggregation needs to be computed.

Measure.description: The Measure element contains an expression which is a reference to a measure in a source table.

Min.description: The Min element contains an expression whose min aggregation needs to be computed.

NativeReferenceName.description: The name by which the expression can be referenced in native expressions.

NativeVisualCalculation.description:

Not.description: The Not element contains an expression which represents a "not" of an expression that evaluate to a boolean value.

Now.description: The Now element contains an expression which returns the current date and time.

Or.description: The And element contains an expression which represents an "or" between two expressions that evaluate to a boolean value.

Percentile.description: The Percentile element contains an expression which computes a percentile of an expression.

PropertyVariationSource.description: PropertyVariationSource is an element which represents a reference to a source of variations associated with a property.

RoleRef.description: The RoleRef element contains an expression which is a reference to a named Role defined by a Visual.

SelectRef.description: The SelectRef element contains an expression which is a reference to a named item in the select clause of the query.

SourceRef.description: The SourceRef element contains an expression which is reference to a source table in the query or the data.

StartsWith.description: The StartsWith element contains an expression which is a "starts with" comparison between two expressions.

This represents the position in the field well where the field parameter is located.
A field well can contain either projections or field parameters.
When this index is changed, it affects where the field parameter's projected fields will be inserted
in the projections list.

This indicates how many fields the parameter will project into when evaluated.

This value will be re-computed when the parameter is evaluated, which is when the visual is rendered.

sortDirection.description:
If the sort direction is set, the visual is sorted by this field parameter.
The implication of a visual being sorted by a field parameter is as follows:
- If none of the newly projected fields exist in the sort list, apply the parameter sort direction to the first projected field and add it to the end of the sort list.
- If all the projected fields in the sort list have the opposite sort direction as the parameter's sort direction, flip the parameter's sort direction.

Should be between 0 and height of the containing page.

z.description:
Defines the stacking order for the visual.
Higher z-index visuals are shown on top of the lower ones.

groupMode.description: Defines how the visuals are organized inside this group.

objects.description: Specifies the formatting to be set for different "objects" of this group.

properties.description: Describes the properties of the object to apply formatting changes to.

selector.description:
Defines the scope at which to apply the formatting for this object.
Can also define rules for matching highlighted values and how multiple definitions for the same property should be ordered.

$schema.description: Defines the schema to use for an item.

annotations.description: Additional information to be saved (for example comments, readme, etc) for this visual.

filterConfig.description: Filters that apply to all this visual - on top of the filters defined for the report and page.

howCreated.description: Source of creation of this visual.

name.description: A unique identifier for the visual across the whole page.

parentGroupName.description: Name of the parent group (visual container), if it is part of one.

position.description:
Defines where the visual is position on the page and how big it should be, along
with z-index (stacking) for that visual.
Also defines the order in which visuals are navigated when using just keyboard (tabOrder).

visual.description: Defines a chart to be shown inside of this container.

visualGroup.description: Defines that this container should be used as a grouping container.

DatasetReference.description: The DatasetReference defines the semantic model that is bound to this report. It is required to have exactly one of either the byPath or byConnection properties. The byConnection property would typically be used for LiveConnect scenarios whereas byPath would point at a local semantic model.
DatasetReference.title: DatasetReference

ReportDatasetReferenceByConnection.description: Provides a reference to a remote semantic model using a connection string. The connection string must point to a semantic model hosted in the Microsoft Fabric service.  Connections to other Analysis Services semantic models must use a byPath reference to a semantic model definition containing a modelReference.json file.

connectionString.description: The connection string referring to the remote semantic model.
connectionString.title: ConnectionString

ReportDatasetReferenceByConnection.title: ByConnection

ReportDatasetReferenceByPath.description: Provides a reference to a local dataset artifact definition.

path.description: A relative path from this file to the target semantic model artifact folder. Uses ‘/’ as a directory separator.
path.title: Path

ReportDatasetReferenceByPath.title: ByPath

https://developer.microsoft.com/json-sch.description: The ReportDefinition is stored as definition.pbir. It contains metadata about the overall file structure, holds core settings, and holds a reference to the semantic model used by this report. This file is required.

version.description: Version of the report artifact file format.  This also serves as the version number for the .pbir file format.
version.title: Version

https://developer.microsoft.com/json-sch.title: ReportDefinition

DatasetSettings.description: Settings for this semantic model that do not impact the behavior of the data model itself. Instead, these settings control the behavior of other Power BI features associated with the semantic model.

qnaEnabled.description: Whether Q&A is enabled for this semantic model.
qnaEnabled.title: QnaEnabled

qnaLsdlSharingPermissions.description: Describes how the linguistic schema (LSDL) can be shared with other users within the same tenant. Allowed values are 0 (LSDL can be shared with users with read permission) and 1 (LSDL can be shared with all users).
qnaLsdlSharingPermissions.title: QnaLsdlSharingPermissions

DatasetSettings.title: Settings

https://developer.microsoft.com/json-sch.description: The DatasetDefinition stored as definition.pbism holds information about the overall semantic model definition. This file is required.

version.description: Version of the semantic model item file format. This also serves as the version number for the .pbism file format.
version.title: Version

https://developer.microsoft.com/json-sch.title: DatasetDefinition
